card.name: Slots before connect-type words
card.fires_on: Scattered words where a form of 'connect' or 'connection' could plausibly come next, such as 'in' in all-caps warning text, 'also' in hardware descriptions, and the apostrophe in O'CONNOR.

modes.label: Hardware descriptions
modes.description: Words in patent-style computer hardware text, such as bus bridge or peripheral device lists, where 'connected' is likely nearby.
modes.example: Peripheral component interconnect (PCI) bus bridge 21<<4>> connected to I/O bus 21

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: Short linking words like 'in' or 'than' in capitalized label warnings.

modes.label: Name containing CONN
modes.description: The apostrophe inside the name O'CONNOR, just before 'CONN'.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'connect' and related words such as connected and connection.
card.plain: It fires at spots where a word like 'connected' or 'connection' might come next, in hardware text, capitalized warnings and the name O'Connor.
